exposure: Curriculum content and competencies related to prenatal and pediatric oral health
Content delivery methods and hours spent
outcome: Integration of prenatal and pediatric oral health into core curriculum
Designation of prenatal and pediatric oral health as core competencies
Reporting of teaching professional policies and guidelines
Hours spent on prenatal and didactic/clinical experiences
Reported barriers to prenatal and pediatric clinical experience
cohort: The study participants were 124 dental hygiene program directors from university and community college dental hygiene programs across the United States.
finding: Most dental hygiene programs incorporate prenatal and pediatric oral health content and professional guidelines into their curriculum, but designated core competencies for these areas are lower, and clinical patient care experiences are frequently limited by a lack of patients.
